criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: Queries about ordering, activating, replacing, linking, or general usage of physical or virtual cards, including PIN management, ATM interactions, and associated fees.

categories.name: Card Security & Fraud
categories.definition: Queries about lost or stolen cards, unauthorized transactions, freezing accounts due to security concerns, or reporting fraud.

categories.name: Transaction Issues
categories.definition: Queries about failed, pending, declined, reverted, or incorrect transactions such as transfers, payments, top-ups, withdrawals, or deposits, including double charges and associated fees.

categories.name: Refunds & Disputes
categories.definition: Queries about requesting refunds, disputing charges, or resolving issues with merchants or unrecognized direct debits.

categories.name: Currency Exchange
categories.definition: Queries about exchange rates, currency conversion, supported currencies, and associated fees.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: Queries about opening, closing, updating personal details, or general access to an account.

categories.name: Identity Verification
categories.definition: Queries about the process, requirements, or issues related to verifying identity or source of funds.

categories.name: Top-up Methods
categories.definition: Queries about how to add money to an account, supported methods, limits, and associated fees.

categories.name: App/Technical Support
categories.definition: Queries about general application functionality issues not related to specific banking transactions or features.
